propositions: Three near-identical walkers for discovering ticket replacement links (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) differ only in liveness check and return type and must be consolidated into a single shared core function.

The consolidation must preserve behavioural differences: _has_live_replacement_link applies ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing for non-bugs (fc20 ticket); _recorded_replacement_target continues to inbound scan after subject reduce failure while others return early.

The replacement-link walk (find_inbound_relationships + supersedes) must appear only once in src/rebar, guarded by a construct-uniqueness test that scans for the conjunction of both atoms with mandatory escape marker.
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be aliased to DISPOSITION_CLASSES (same object identity, not equality) to prevent the two sets from drifting, as they did in bug frolicky-dependable-peccary.

Three monkeypatch seams (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) must keep exact names and signatures; find_replacement in particular retains its 3-positional-arg signature.

The shared core takes on_subject_unreadable parameter to handle reduce-failure divergence: 'stop' for live-mode callers (matching early return) and 'continue' for recorded-target mode (weaker "was one ever recorded?" question).
